notes:
Native google-genai passthrough on Vertex AI: request.json is the raw body a google-genai client sends to the gateway's /v1beta/models/{model}:{action} route; the gateway resolves the model to a provider configured for Vertex AI and doGenAIRequest / StreamGenerateContent relay it to the publisher-model URL (.../v1beta1/projects/

/locations//publishers/google/models/:), returning the upstream status and body untouched. The 429 answered to streamGenerateContent (the stream_ prefix makes the case a stream, as the recorder's streamOf does: a native body has no stream key). The body is Vertex AI's 429 for dynamic shared quota (RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, no details, no retry hint), as vertex@gemini-3.8-flash/error_rate_limit. The error body is google.rpc.Status in its HTTP JSON mapping ({"error": {code, message, status, details}}); status names and their HTTP codes come from googleapis google/rpc/code.proto, details from google/rpc/error_details.proto and google/api/error_reason.proto (read 2026-10-28). Not recordable.

sanity_gaps.reason: known gap G22: StreamGenerateContent turns an upstream 4xx into ErrUpstreamProvider, a 502 whose message is the raw upstream body; on Vertex AI as on the Gemini API, the native stream route answers the google-genai client a 502 INTERNAL instead of relaying the 429 (the non-streaming call relays it: genai_error_rate_limit)
